reviewMethod: All 15 final screenshots inspected with view_image. Three-language starter, binding parameters and event history are legible and scrollable; actions are reachable at 390px. Desktop event order, media receipt and physical collider selection are visible. Event-origin source navigation opens the behavior document as specified by its existing contract.
limitations: Native collider navigation has an exact physics source selection. Project-event publisher, animation subscriber and audio subscriber sources carry distinct frozen propertyPath values, but the existing event-origin contract supplies no sourceRange; these actions open the behavior document without an exact text selection.

Long starter descriptions remain readable by scrolling the existing dialog body; the long Japanese native select label uses its existing ellipsis. Create/Cancel and binding Apply/Cancel actions remain reachable at 390px.
This is a real HTTP editor plus native Godot headless run. It verifies executed media commands, not audible audio or hardware; installed Tauri, Android and Bevy are outside this run.
The finite ordinary publisher run uses the existing cumulative 128-publication project event budget; no unlimited ordinary event-publication claim is made.
